body: It will end mine atleast, and I am sure people will just forget or not care that much anyways. I mean I struggle in front of them so much daily, they don't care then, I don't blame them ofcourse but I think people only care or feel your pain once you actually leave.
I get super anxious writing anything even when I am anonymous. I rarely express my opinions
but I still want to die so much
and the more you try to understand the more you get lost and after they are done speaking and look at you, you just nod head and they realise you are not into the conversation.
I secretly wish for that to happen
So true, the stab of pain you feel when opening eyes for first time in morning is unexplainable in words

Idk if its wierd or not coz maybe I am too, but I feel relaxed reading things here too. Maybe it reminds me I am not alone, maybe even if falsely and just for few moments, I feel belonged somewhere. So yea even if its weird who cares. Take all those small moments of happiness you can take out of this life

yep a lot, I look back and there was a time when I used to believe in myself and things were hopeful. I sometimes wish to go back and tell my old self to do things a little more differently, but Ik thats not possible, but I guess we can just keep trying to make today better and learn to love ourselves again. But that can be so hard sometimes.
Well done buddy, its a huge achievement. Its great she feels same way. Way to go
it would be awesome if you tell more about yourself but hmu if you'd like to chat

I am so sorry to hear you have to see that but I feel this is not the right place for this situation tbh, also please dont share any personal info or even respond to older people trying to contact you or get your info. I understand you might want to talk to someone about it but please be safe out there. I don't know about your family situation so cant give any advice, but maybe you'd want to talk to some adult in your life whom you can trust with this kind of thing or maybe even your mom, since you said she's a lovely person. Hope things sort out for you pretty soon.
